observations.body: Paul recalls exhorting each person toward a walk worthy of the God who calls them into his Kingdom and glory.

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside called into god’s kingdom and glory.

payload.posture: Read 1 Thessalonians 2:7–12 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states paul recalls exhorting each person toward a walk worthy of the God who calls them into his Kingdom and glory. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
